rules.statement: A person aggrieved by a decision made under section 57(1)(b) of the Financial Statute may appeal against it to the Commissioner within thirty days after the service of notice.
rules.supporting_quote: Section 79(1) of the said Financial Statute states any person aggrieved by the decision made under section 57(1)(b) may appeal against it to the 1st Respondent Commissioner within thirty days after the service of notice.
